summary: Dependency-confusion beacon: load-time DNS exfiltration of hostname to attacker-controlled OOB domain
details: On require()/import of @galicia-toolkit-nestjs/paas@999.0.3, index.js reads os.hostname() and performs a DNS resolution against <hostname>.p999.dc.oob.s4yhii.com, encoding the installer's hostname into the subdomain label so the authoritative resolver for s4yhii.com records it. The scoped name combined with the implausibly high 999.0.3 version is the canonical dependency-confusion shape — a package published to the public registry under an internal-looking scope with a version chosen to win resolution against a private package of the same name. Load-time execution confirms both that an internal build pulled this public package and the hostname of the environment that did so, delivering reconnaissance signal to the operator of s4yhii.com.
